facts.hours: Sun, Mon & Thu 5–9pm; Fri–Sat 5–9:30pm; brunch Sat–Sun 11am–2pm; closed Tue & Wed
facts.menuNote: Prices from the Oakland dinner and brunch menus and the SF dinner menu on their own site. Brunch is Saturday and Sunday, 11am to 2pm, in Oakland.
facts.siteNote: A 1% Dining For Justice surcharge goes on every check to help feed houseless neighbors; ask if you'd like to opt out. Kid-friendly, and dogs on a leash are welcome. The food is typically gluten-free unless noted, with one or two vegan options. Brunch tacos are on La Palma flour tortillas, corn on request. The Oakland space can be bought out for up to 50 guests.

panels.head: Both shops
body: Oakland — 420 40th St, "in the alley": Sunday, Monday and Thursday 5pm to 9pm, Friday and Saturday 5pm to 9:30pm, brunch Saturday and Sunday 11am to 2pm.
San Francisco — 530 Haight St, "in the bar" at Woods Lowside: tacos Monday and Thursday to Sunday, 5pm to 9pm, in-house or to go.

glenn: 27 Oct 7:01 pm: Instagram screenshots of @tacososcar ('TAC🍉S 🍉SCAR', 24.6K followers: 420 40th St. 'In the alley' Oakland, 530 Haight St. 'In the bar' San Pancho, closed Tues & Weds, link tacososcar.com/menu, call (719) 266-2837, tacososcar@gmail.com), 'https://www.tacososcar.com/', 'Oakland • Eats / BEASTY • Eats'.
flags: Phone (719) 266-2837 (a Colorado area code) is only on their Instagram contact button; their site lists no phone, and Foodle and ZoomInfo give (510) 735-9620. Instagram's number is used.

Google and Yelp not checked: the Chrome extension was not connected and Yelp returned 403. Oakland hours checked against the Michelin Guide instead, which matches their site exactly; Atmosfy and one Fine Dining Lovers version omit Saturday brunch.

SF hours are from Woods Lowside's own page (kitchen Mon, Thu–Sun 5–9pm). Apple Maps gives the SF listing Oakland's schedule (weekend brunch, 9:30pm Fri–Sat); SF Chronicle (Nov 2025) said Thu–Mon from 5pm. SF hours go in the panel only; the hours field is Oakland's.
No orderUrl: their 'Order Online Here!' button (Upserve, app.upserve.com/s/tacos-oscar-oakland) is set to hidden on every screen size.
The SF Charred Broccoli Taco (Mama Lam's satay, 50% to No Immigrants, No Spice) was a 24–26 Oct 2026 collab per ma.to, so the SF menu page may be out of date.
SF drinks list only 'Woods Beer & Wine Co.' with no prices, so none are shown.
Visit Oakland lists the shop at 481 Water St, Oakland 94607; that address is not used.

Their Instagram avatar is now a cactus drawing on pale blue (about #88D0F0), not the egg wordmark; the logo is the wordmark from their site, and the color #00CCFF is the bright blue their site uses for 'TACOS' and its buttons.
Brunch menu items repeat Charred Broccoli Taco, Chips y Salsa Morita and the hot sauce from dinner; kept as they publish them.
